scientific_integrity: An analytic spectral and polynomial root-count proof handles all existing conference graphs. A standard-library exact-rational program gives finite spot checks, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on the existence of a conference graph at the stated integer parameter; it concerns completed Radau IIA endpoint positivity only. No exhaustive priority claim or independent validation is asserted.
title: Thirteen vertices are the sharp Radau IIA positivity boundary on conference graphs
